source_refs.note: Exercise 3.5, Question 10: show-that with f(4 - x) = f(x); book p. 102. No printed answer (show that).

blocks.explanation:
Yeh saboot (proof) wala sawal hai: left side mein \(f(2x)\) hai aur right side mein \(f(x)\).
Diya kya hai? \(f(4 - x) = f(x)\), yani \(f\) ka graph \(x = 2\) ke ird gird aaine ki tarah barabar hai.
Kya saabit karna hai? Dono integrals barabar hain.
Rule kaunsa? Pehle \(u = 2x\) rakh kar 2 ko hatayenge; interval \([0, 4]\) ban jayega aur saath \(\frac{1}{2}\) aayega. Phir symmetry aur Property VI se \(\int_0^4 f = 2\int_0^2 f\).
Plan: substitution, symmetry, cancel.
Yaad rakhiye: proof mein hum jawab se shuru nahi karte; left side se chal kar qadam ba qadam right side tak pohanchte hain, aur har qadam ki wajah likhte hain.
steps:
Diya gaya: har \(x\) ke liye \(f(4 - x) = f(x)\).
Saabit karna: \(\int_{0}^{2} f(2x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: substitution \(u = 2x\), phir Property VI: agar \(f(a - x) = f(x)\) ho to \(\int_0^{a} f = 2\int_0^{a/2} f\), yahan \(a = 4\).

\(u = 2x\) rakhein
\[du = 2\,dx,\quad x = 0 \Rightarrow u = 0,\quad x = 2 \Rightarrow u = 4\]
\[\int_{0}^{2} f(2x)\,dx = \dfrac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{4} f(u)\,du\]
Kyun: \(dx = \frac{1}{2}du\), aur limits bhi naye variable ki: \(x = 2\) par \(u = 4\). Yani \(f(2x)\) ka graph \(f\) ko aadha daba deta hai, is liye interval double aur area aadha.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{1}{2}\) aur nayi upar wali limit 4, dono zaroori hain.

Symmetry istemal karein (Property VI, \(a = 4\))
\[\int_{0}^{4} f(u)\,du = \int_{0}^{2} \big(f(u) + f(4 - u)\big)\,du\]
\[= 2\int_{0}^{2} f(u)\,du\]
Kyun: \(f(4 - u) = f(u)\) diya hai, is liye bracket \(2f(u)\) ban gaya. Matlab \([0, 2]\) aur \([2, 4]\) dono aadhon ka area barabar hai.

Milayein
\[\int_{0}^{2} f(2x)\,dx = \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot 2\int_{0}^{2} f(u)\,du\]
\[= \int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{2}\) aur 2 cancel ho gaye. Variable ka naam \(u\) ho ya \(x\), definite integral ki value wohi rehti hai (Property I), kyunke aakhir mein sirf limits rakhi jati hain aur variable ghaib ho jata hai. Is tarah left side qadam ba qadam right side ban gayi, aur yahi saboot hai.

Tasdeeq: ek misaal se
\[f(x) = (x - 2)^2:\ \int_{0}^{2} (2x - 2)^2\,dx = \dfrac{8}{3}\]
\[\int_{0}^{2} (x - 2)^2\,dx = \dfrac{8}{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \((x - 2)^2\) condition poori karta hai: \(f(4 - x) = (2 - x)^2 = (x - 2)^2\). Dono sides ki value \(\frac{8}{3}\) aayi, to result is misaal par sach hai.
